hero.title: Where
hero.subtitle: In the heart of the Masovian countryside, just south of Warsaw, RK Warszawa has been home to riders of all ages and skill levels for over 25 years. From a child’s first lesson to refining the skills of experienced competitors — this is where a true equestrian journey begins.
hero.imageAlt: Bay horse and rider mid-air clearing a show jumping obstacle

about.title: More than
about.p1: RK Warszawa was founded in Warsaw in 1998 as a small family stable — three horses, one arena, and a deep belief that horseback riding changes people. Today, we are one of the most respected equestrian centers in the Warsaw region.
about.p2: Home to over 40 horses, eight dedicated instructors, and a community of riders who return season after season — some now bringing their own children — RK Warszawa is a place built on patience, progress, and a genuine love for horses.

team.title: Our
team.subtitle: Each instructor brings unique experience — from competing internationally to therapeutic riding — united by a shared passion for horses and dedication to every rider’s development.

robert.name: Robert Kowalczyk
robert.title: School Director & Head Instructor
robert.bio: With 25 years of experience in competitive dressage, Robert founded RK Warszawa on the belief that every rider deserves patient, progressive training built on trust—not force.

matylda.name: Matylda Weigel
matylda.title: Show Jumping Instructor
matylda.bio: A former member of the Polish national show jumping team, Matylda helps riders build confidence and develop their skills—from their first pole exercises to navigating 1.20 m courses.

stableTeam.title: The Stable
stableTeam.intro: Our horses are only as happy as the people who care for them every day. The stable crew is the backbone of RK Warszawa — dedicated, experienced, and deeply committed to horse welfare.

horse.name: Horse First
horse.desc: Every decision begins with the horse’s wellbeing. Happy, healthy horses create better riders and more fulfilling partnerships.

learning.name: Progressive Learning
learning.desc: We believe in building strong foundations before advancing further. No rider is rushed — every skill is developed through patient, consistent work.

openToAll.name: Open to Everyone
openToAll.desc: Whether you are five or fifty-five, nervous or ambitious — there is a place for you at RK Warszawa. Horse riding is for everyone.

oferta.title: Our
oferta.pageDesc: Programs tailored to every level — from your first meeting with a horse to sport training under certified PZJ instructors.

firstSteps.name: First Steps in Riding
firstSteps.desc: Lessons designed for those who want to begin their equestrian journey from the ground up. An ideal first contact with a horse — in safe conditions and under instructor supervision. We teach how to approach a horse safely, build a relationship with them, and what basic stable work and first experiences in the saddle look like.
items: learning a safe approach to the horse
understanding horse behaviour and basic communication
learning to groom and prepare the horse for riding
learning to tack up and prepare equipment
first exercises in the saddle under instructor supervision

pzjInstructor.name: Riding with a PZJ Instructor
pzjInstructor.desc: Lessons for riders with basic experience who want to develop their skills under a certified PZJ instructor. Training allows independent work with the horse, refining riding technique, and consciously building the horse–rider relationship. The instructor observes progress and provides individual guidance and recommendations for future development.
items: work in the saddle under instructor supervision

sport.name: Sport Training
sport.desc: Sport training for advanced riders and competitors preparing for shows. We focus on developing riding technique, improving seat and precision, and preparing the horse–rider pair for sport work and competition.
sport.note: Details arranged individually with the trainer.
items: training tailored to the rider's and horse's level

facilities.title: World-Class
facilities.pageDesc: Every corner of RK Warszawa has been designed with both horse and rider in mind — providing the best possible environment for learning, competing, and simply being around horses.

indoor.name: Indoor Riding Arena
indoor.desc: Our flagship 60 × 20 m indoor arena is the heart of RK Warszawa. Fully lit and climate-controlled, it allows year-round riding regardless of the weather — essential in our region.

outdoor.name: Outdoor Competition Arena
outdoor.desc: Our 80 × 40 m outdoor arena meets competition standards. It features premium sand footing with excellent drainage and consistent conditions year-round.

stables.name: Modern Stable Block
stables.desc: 50 spacious stalls built to the highest animal welfare standards. Every horse at RK Warszawa lives in comfort — with natural light, ventilation, and attentive daily care.
specs: Full grooming and secure tack room
Wash bays with hot and cold water

crossCountry.name: Cross-country Course
crossCountry.desc: Stretching across 12 hectares of natural terrain, the cross-country course offers 28 permanent obstacles at three difficulty levels — perfect for training and building confidence in varied terrain.

lounge.name: Viewing Lounge & Café
lounge.desc: A warm, welcoming space overlooking the indoor arena. Enjoy coffee and light meals while watching lessons or waiting for your rider.

paddocks.name: Paddocks & Pastures
paddocks.desc: 14 individual paddocks and 6 group pastures provide horses with daily turnout on safe, well-maintained fields with shelters and water.

parking.name: Parking & Trailer Area
parking.desc: Large parking area with dedicated space for horse trailer maneuvering. Easy direct access to the stable grounds.

solarium.name: Horse Solarium
solarium.desc: Professional solarium for drying and warming horses after exercise — especially valuable during colder months.

vet.name: Farrier & Veterinary Station
vet.desc: A dedicated, well-lit area for farrier and veterinary visits — designed for safety and comfort.

warmUp.name: Competition Warm-up Arena
warmUp.desc: Warm-up arena next to the main arenas, used for pre-competition training and clinics.

quote.text: A horse is a mirror to your soul — and sometimes you may not like what you see, but the horse never lies.
quote.author: — Marta L., RK Warszawa rider since 2017

home.title: Ready to begin your
home.body: Whether you’re asking for yourself or your child — our team will answer every question and help you find the right program. No riding experience required.

horses.title: Want to ride one of
horses.body: Tell us about your experience level and goals, and we’ll match you with the right horse and instructor from day one.

facilities.title: See it
facilities.body: We’d love to show you around — contact us to schedule a stable visit and meet some of our horses.

oferta.title: Interested in
oferta.body: Get in touch — we’ll help you choose the right program for your level and riding goals.

team.title: Want to train with
team.body: Contact us and we’ll match you with the right instructor for your goals and experience level.

contact.pageDesc: Whether you’re ready to book your first lesson or simply want to take a look around — we’d love to hear from you.

form.title: We’ll reply
form.intro: Use this form to ask about lessons, boarding, visits, or anything else. We usually reply within one business day.
